description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2164/5 of 24.02.2020
reasoning: This gazette content specifically concerns the election and declaration of a Deputy Mayor for the Kalmunai Municipal Council, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It is an amendment to a previous election result notification, making it directly related to electoral processes, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
